title: pluchea rubelliflora
intro: Pluchea rubelliflora, commonly known as Red Mallow, is a plant species native to China and Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in relieving symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Pluchea rubelliflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and immunomodulatory effects. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including snakebites, wounds, and skin infections, due to its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties.
